newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso dips 3.3 vs dlr amid speculation.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso dips 3.3 vs dlr amid speculation.

text.p: Colombia's peso fell 3.3 to 1,104 against the dollar Thursday in speculative trading, interbank dealers said.
"Banks with short dollar positions were fueling the speculation...the demand and supply of greenbacks was fairly even," one dealer said.
He said there were few petro-dollars or coffee export earnings entering the markets, a situation likely to persist throughout the rest of the month.
Dealers reported 417 operations worth a total $193 million. The peso opened at 1,102.9 and hit an intraday high of 1,101.3 and a low of 1,104.25.
